name: Rafael Souza
bio:
Rafael's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While working as an apprentice auto body repairman in São Paulo, he discovered a talent for custom paint jobs. His meticulous attention to detail caught the eye of a local racing team, who hired him to handle their livery designs and paintwork. After several successful seasons perfecting his craft, he was approached by Carlin Academy, eager to bring his expertise and artistic flair to their organization.

Rafael is known for his innovative paint techniques, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible with colors and finishes. He is exceptionally skilled at color matching and ensuring the highest quality paint application, crucial for both aesthetics and aerodynamic performance. His dedication to perfection and unwavering loyalty make him a valuable asset to the Carlin Academy team. He understands that in motorsport, even the smallest detail can make the difference between victory and defeat, and treats every paint job with the utmost care.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave
physical.description: Rafael is of average height with a wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always wears a pair of lucky racing gloves while mixing paints.
Has a collection of miniature racing cars on his workbench.
Listens to Brazilian samba music while working to maintain focus and rhythm.
